title: Order reversal identifies standard horns and boundaries
statement: Use small simplicial sets and horns of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and boundaries of [def-weil-pbc-trivial-kan-fibration]. For an operator $\theta:[m]\to[n]$ put $\theta^{\mathrm{rev}}(j)=n-\theta(m-j)$, and let $K^{\mathrm{op}}$ be $K$ precomposed with this involution of the simplex category. The map sending $\theta$ to $\theta^{\mathrm{rev}}$ defines a simplicial isomorphism $r_n:\Delta^n\xrightarrow{\sim}(\Delta^n)^{\mathrm{op}}$. Under this isomorphism, the inverse image of $(\Lambda_i^n)^{\mathrm{op}}$ is $\Lambda_{n-i}^n$ for $n\geq1$ and $0\leq i\leq n$, and the inverse image of $(\partial\Delta^n)^{\mathrm{op}}$ is $\partial\Delta^n$ for every $n\geq0$.
